facts.anchor: I hadn’t been at all surprised when he’d practically growled, “My wife.”
I wanted to know why one of my closest friends was suddenly married to a man I hadn’t even realized she was dating.
“Yes, it’s true. And we’re going to have a huge celebration when we return.
“If I’d had a real wedding,” Cece said, “you definitely would’ve been my maid of honor.”

facts.fact: 她自认：I’m in love with Carson
facts.anchor: Oh shit. My eyes widened at the realization. I’m in love with Carson.
Loving Carson felt as natural as playing hockey—fun, exhilarating, not without challenges, but ultimately rewarding.

facts.fact: 妈妈：你和Lee是我做过最好的事
facts.anchor: You—and Lee—are the best things I’ve ever done.
Even when it comes to Dad. We shared a dream and built a beautiful life together.

facts.fact: 婚姻死亡：很多小事渐积
facts.anchor: It wasn’t one thing. It was lots of little things, and it happened gradually over time.
Only if you promise not to tell anyone. Not Dad, and definitely not Levi.
He turned to me, his gaze on mine as he said, “Who they love.”
He didn’t have to say the words because I knew.
Because Carson and I were a team, pursuing our goals together.
